description:
SGP is seeking skilled Proposal Editors to make federal proposals clear, consistent, compliant, and persuasive. You will refine content from multiple writers and subject matter experts (SMEs) into a cohesive, polished narrative that aligns with evaluation criteria, working collaboratively with proposal managers, writers, and production teams.

You’ll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and be comfortable supporting multiple clients, each with distinct style guides, writing conventions, and review processes. You’ll also have experience collaborating with capture managers, proposal managers, proposal coordinators, writers, graphic designers, and SMEs to maintain consistency in messaging, visuals, and win themes across proposal volumes.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $75 - $85 per hour.

Security Clearance: Active Security Clearance.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you'll enjoy the independence and flexibility of 1099 work while benefiting from the resources, collaboration, and professional support of an experienced capture and proposals team.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who bring diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

Responsibilities

  • Perform substantive editing and copyediting of technical, management, staffing, and past performance volumes.

  • Ensure proposal content addresses solicitation requirements in Sections L and M and aligns with the compliance matrix.

  • Refine lengthy or highly technical drafts to meet page limits while preserving key information and win themes.

  • Develop and maintain client style guides related to ongoing style adherence and update for specific projects, as needed.

  • Maintain consistency in voice, terminology, acronym usage, and adhere to client style guides across volumes.

  • Improve readability through clear topic sentences, feature-to-benefit language, and evaluator-focused organization.

  • Proofread final proposal volumes for grammar, spelling, formatting, cross-references, and consistency.

  • Edit resumes, past performance write-ups, and reusable proposal content.

  • Incorporate revisions efficiently during color reviews and final production.

Required qualifications

  • At least three years of editing experience, including a minimum of two (2) years supporting federal proposals.

  • Expert knowledge of grammar, usage, and a recognized style guide (e.g., Chicago, AP, or GPO).

  • Ability to edit for compliance, clarity, and persuasiveness, in addition to grammatical correctness.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including Track Changes, comments, styles, and templates.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple proposal volumes under tight deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

  • APMP Foundation-level certification.

  • Experience with Shipley proposal development and review practices.

  • Familiarity with federal technical domains, including IT, cybersecurity, engineering, and healthcare.

  • Experience with Adobe Acrobat review tools, PerfectIt, or AI-assisted editing tools.

  • Active Security Clearance.
